resources.string: Run! Zombiez key art: Runner 007 running from zombies toward a red horizon, Haven Base flag in the distance.

Run! Zombiez is a hands-free audio mission. Pick a mission or tap DEMO, put your phone away, and move. Haven Base will guide you through radio transmissions, survivor chatter, and the threats along your route. Tap STOP at any time to abort and return to base.

Music: \"Shadowlands 1 - Horizon,\" \"SCP-x7x (6th Floor),\" and \"Shadowlands 5 - Antechamber\" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
